folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B284: closed audit scope and current intake
folds.body:
The full [original register](RECONCILIATION.md), [extra-audit return B](SEMANTIC_T11_EXTRA_AUDITS_B.md), [root-index return](SEMANTIC_T11_ROOT_INDEXES.md) and [other-index return](SEMANTIC_OTHER_INVENTORY_INDEXES.md) have been read in this project-wide pass. This is content review of those documents, not a second read of their underlying books, games, private receipts or linked reports. The older finite DA/UA closure remains closed. Reading remaining loose material under the November 4 request does not revive the retired automatic 31-source audit queue or make a historical conditional design a new implementation requirement.

Preserve the original register's useful chain from correction to current authority, actual caller and bounded evidence. Its F1–F22 rows distinguish delivered heir/Lin/skill/mixture/story consumers from stale absence; actual local means from superseded universal surcharges; already answered LIQ1 and continuation direction from stale questions; valid seeded-native QA and retries from the retired natural-only failed-closed rule; source integration from copied report aliases; and available archive counterparts from byte-equivalent recovery of missing original trees. Its old proposed shared-owner edits and A1–A5 queue must be read with the later closure above, not used as fresh dispatch. LOTM plan-only and R6 unfinished labels, old source hashes, queue totals and 1366×768 target are dated snapshots. Use current project/domain authority for present claims.

The B return preserves 11 source rows, 988 historical source lines and 194 path-local finding records. Its six joins keep heir leftovers separate from broad genealogy, M01–M33 cosmology hypotheses separate from chosen local collision rules, mixed status-window fixes separate from unexercised sleep, source-repaired book findings separate from gameplay/persistence, and terse absorption receipts separate from their detailed reports. A label list is not a new per-finding semantic read of the private receipt. Repeated F/P identifiers, including the five MOL P1/P2 labels, retain source and row identity.

The three root indexes retain direct-versus-variant start lineage, a repaired import following the original false PASS, local pricing versus free exceptional vows, and UI manifest exclusions. The eight other indexes retain 397 individually recorded rows, including navigation-only versus captured versus selectively read Qud source and native-unverified system coverage. Their adoption statuses and 48-directory routing count are reported inventory states, not current implementation or full-source coverage. The depth7 pointer was current for that return; no new latest-depth inspection is supplied here. No linked class body, source book, private pack, screenshot, save or gameplay proof is newly reviewed by these joins.

Preserve ideas and historical failures in place. Full-text receipt/index review and actual implementation review are different dispositions. This pass creates no new audit authority, private-source exposure, runtime work, deletion, relocation or external action.
